description: This file implements the TransactionalStateFactory class, which provides methods to create transactional state instances and configure JSON serializer settings within Orleans framework's transactional system.

classes.name: TransactionalStateFactory
classes.description: Factory class responsible for creating transactional state objects and handling JSON serialization settings for Orleans Transactions.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates and returns a new transactional state instance of type TState using the provided configuration.

methods.name: GetJsonSerializerSettings
methods.description: Retrieves and configures JSON serializer settings with reference preservation disabled, using the Orleans JSON serializer settings provider.
